peasants = {
	can_always_hire = yes
}

laborers = {
	can_always_hire = yes
}

farmers = {
	qualifications = {
		value = 1
		if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = peasants }
			multiply = 4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = laborers }
			multiply = 2
		}
	}
}

machinists = {
	qualifications = {
		value = literacy
		multiply = 20
		if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = laborers }
			multiply = 3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = farmers }
			multiply = 1.5
		}
	}
}

engineers = {
	qualifications = {
		value = literacy
		multiply = 30
		if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = machinists }
			multiply = 4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = academics }
			multiply = 2
		}
	}
}

academics = {
	qualifications = {
		value = literacy
		multiply = 40
		if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = bureaucrats }
			multiply = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = engineers }
			multiply = 2
		}
	}
}

aristocrats = {
	qualifications = {
		value = wealth
		subtract = 10
		add = {
			value = literacy
			multiply = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = farmers }
			multiply = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = bureaucrats }
			multiply = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = officers }
			multiply = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = capitalists }
			multiply = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = clergymen }
			multiply = 2
		}
	}
}

capitalists = {
	qualifications = {
		value = 1
		if = {
			limit = { wealth < 20 }
			multiply = 0
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_pop_type = shopkeepers }
			multiply = 2
		}
	}
}
